run_binary_size_diff: run the binary size diff tool comparing current gRPC Objective-C build against a base commit
build_gRPC_sample: build the gRPC Objective-C sample project with or without frameworks using the build function
get_size_frameworks: get the binary sizes of gRPC Core, ObjC, BoringSSL, Protobuf, and Total for a build
dir_size_calculate: calculate the total size of all files recursively within a given directory path
parse_link_map_sizes: parse a link map file to extract binary component sizes for static builds
